notes.title: Major Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42544928/7966ccb101ea889a8117523d3bd412223c6499ff.png[/img]

[h1]Changelog[/h1]

[list]
[*] [spoiler]Calisto[/spoiler] discovery about the Enigma of Fear is now available in the Cathedral from [spoiler]Jaser perspective[/spoiler] 
[*] Now it is possible to choose text and audio language separately 
[*] The [spoiler]Eye of the God of Fear[/spoiler] now has more details about [spoiler]its function[/spoiler] 
[*] Improvements to the pistol aiming system 
[*] Adds Lupi's rug in the Basement 
[*] Adjustment of Mia's portraits in dialogue after [spoiler] Transcending [/spoiler] 
[*] Small adjustments to evidence 
[*] Mia no longer exits stealth mode when switching items
[*] New art of Goliath and Abraham in the Strach Mansion 
[*] Small adjustments to the Mental Map 
[*] Adjustment in which the HUD in the [spoiler]Eye of the God of Fear[/spoiler] room would not appear correctly in specific resolutions 
[*] Texture optimization and memory usage 
[*] Added SteamDeck support
[/list]

Although most of the performance issues and bugs have been addressed, we will keep listening to your feedbacks and providing support. 

If you wanna get in touch with us, visit our [url=https://discord.com/invite/dumativa]Discord[/url].

Although some performance issues have been addressed, optimization work continues. For more feedback and to report bugs, visit our [url=https://discord.com/invite/dumativa]Discord[/url].

notes.title: Major BUG Fix
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42544928/7966ccb101ea889a8117523d3bd412223c6499ff.png[/img]

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*] Mindmap is activated
[*] Fixing evidence that persisted invisible after a Graveyard Boss Fight
[*] Adjusting dialogue being unlocked early in Spiral CastleIt 
[*] Fixing Transcend softlock 
[*] The ritual book is now no longer invisible to Transcend
[*] Collision adjustments to prevent the player from falling.
[*] Checking for a bug in specific situations where the Underground’s Numeric Keypads did not work even with the correct password.
[*] Lupi’s dialogue fixed.
[*] Dialogues localization bugs.
[*] Fixed bug that caused Mia to dangle in front of a door in the Underground.
[*] Echoes sprites and portrait fixes.
[*] Minor adjustments and text corrections in several pieces of evidence.
[*] Activating the tombstones in a certain sequence within the Labyrinth that was appearing without tombstones before.
[*] The specific sequence now can be repeated forever, as it should be.
[*] Adjustments to the credits screen.
[*] “Butter on Butter” Collectable Puzzle is now fixed
[*] Collision adjustments to prevent the player from getting stuck in some areas.
[*] When defeated in the last Boss Fight, it is no longer necessary to redo the entire initial sequence again.
[/list]

We are aware of some performance issues causing the game to take a long time to open or experience low FPS in certain areas. We are planning to release a compatibility and optimization patch soon.

If you have more feedbacks, visit our [url=https://discord.com/invite/dumativa]Discord[/url].
